preimages.meaning: 原 li r25, 0x40b (默认视角速度加载)。/ Original li r25, 0x40b (default camera speed load).
原 li r25, 0x34b (瞄准视角速度加载)。/ Original li r25, 0x34b (aim camera speed load).

anchors.meaning: Hook 前的 cmpwi r0, 0；codecave 必须保留其 CR 结果。/ cmpwi r0, 0 before the hook; the codecave must preserve its CR result.

license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：仅应在 60 FPS 运行时启用；按所选预设把普通视角基值 `0x40B` 和瞄准视角基值 `0x34B` 统一缩放到 40%..120%，默认预设为 70%，用来校正 60 FPS 下过快或不合手感的镜头转速。 状态：Runtime Experimental，默认关闭。 / English: Enable only while running at 60 FPS; the selected preset uniformly scales normal-camera base `0x40B` and aiming-camera base `0x34B` across 40%..120%, defaulting to 70% to correct camera rotation that feels too fast or unsuitable at 60 FPS. Status: Runtime Experimental; disabled by default.
